provenance.note: Two prosecution authorities (TFL, TVL), no courtCentre fields, hearingDays empty.
provenance.operatorDescription: Runs the transform twice. Variant "fresh-payload" re-reads the inputs; variant "shared-payload" feeds the SAME in-memory hearing object to the second run.
provenance.operatorRationale: A re-shared hearing is delivered twice, and SetInformantRegister mutates the hearing it is given — DefendantContextBaseService.js:77,90,107-118 write level/prosecutionCaseId/offenceId/offenceTitle onto judicialResult nodes, and RegisterFragmentService.js:11-17 REPLACES judicialResultPrompts with the court-extract-filtered subset. "fresh-payload" is the honest re-delivery and is the parity obligation: same bytes in, identical documents out. "shared-payload" is retained as a NEGATIVE CONTROL and is marked PRODUCER_IMPLAUSIBLE, because two deliveries cannot share a JS object: each is a separate orchestration whose hearing arrives through HearingResultedCacheQuery as freshly parsed JSON, and each activity call is a serialised boundary (oracle/lib/boundary.js). Its value is that it now PROVES the mutation cannot cross a delivery — the two variants are identical by construction, and a future change that makes them diverge is a harness defect, not a discovery.

operatorDetail.why: the honest re-delivery: same bytes in, output must be identical
